#document
  <!DOCTYPE html>
  <html>
    <head>
      <title>
        #text "implicit p close"
      </title>
    </head>
    <body>
      #text "\n"
      <p>
        #text "first paragraph\n"
      </p>
      <p>
        #text "second paragraph\n"
      </p>
      <div>
        #text "a div closes the open p"
      </div>
      #text "\n"
      <p>
        #text "third\n"
      </p>
      <address>
        #text "address closes p too"
      </address>
      #text "\n"
      <p>
        #text "fourth\n"
      </p>
      <ul>
        <li>
          #text "list item"
        </li>
      </ul>
      #text "\n"
      <p>
        #text "fifth\n"
      </p>
      <h1>
        #text "heading closes p"
      </h1>
      #text "\n"
    </body>
  </html>
